The lake at the heart of Our Lord's mini: Iria rĩrĩa rĩrĩ ngoro-inĩ ya wĩra wa Mwathani witũ, kũrĩa Atũmwo maagũragia thamaki na kũrĩa aahoreririe rũhuho na makũmbĩ.
Bir Ya'qub, Nablus (ancient Sychar): Gĩthima kĩa Jakubu, Nablus (Sukari wa tene)
One of the most securely identified plac: Kũndũ kũmwe kwa Ivanjeli kũrĩa kũmenyekaine mũno: gĩthima kĩrĩa Jakubu eenjire, rĩu kĩrĩ thĩinĩ wa kanitha wa Ngiriki Orthodox rungu rwa kĩrĩma kĩa Gerizimu.
Church of the Beatitudes, above Tabgha: Kanitha wa Irathimo, igũrũ rĩa Tabgha
Matthew says only that He \"went up the: Mathayo oigaga o atĩ "nĩ aambatire kĩrĩma-inĩ" (Matthew 5:1). Karĩma karĩa karĩ igũrũ rĩa Tabgha nĩ gatĩĩtwo kuuma karine ka kana; kanitha wa ũmũthĩ ũrĩ na mĩena ĩnana, nĩ ũndũ wa Irathimo inyanya.
Nein, south of Mount Tabor: Nein, gũthini wa kĩrĩma kĩa Taboro
A small village on the slope of the Hill: Itũũra inini mwena wa kĩrĩma kĩa More. Kanitha mũnini wa Afransiskani nĩ ũronania harĩa Mwathani witũ aacemanirie na arĩa maakuuĩte kĩimba.
Church of Saint Anne, Old City of Jerusa: Kanitha wa Mũtheru Ana, Itũũra Inene rĩa Tene rĩa Jerusalemu
Archaeologists have uncovered the pool w: Athuthurie a maũndũ ma tene nĩ moonire karia karĩ na ciĩhumbĩro ithano hakuhĩ na Kanitha wa Mũtheru Ana, ũrĩa ũtĩĩtwo ta harĩa Mũirĩtu Theru Maria aaciarĩirwo.
Kursi, on the eastern shore of the Sea o: Kursi, hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia irathĩro cia Iria rĩa Galili
Mark and Luke say \"the territory of the: Mariko na Luka moigaga "bũrũri wa Agerasi", Mathayo "bũrũri wa Agadara". Nyũmba ya amonaki ya Bizantini ya tene kũu Kursi hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia irathĩro nĩ ĩronania kũndũ kũrĩa kũmenyekaine.
Luke sets the feeding near Bethsaida (Lu: Luka oigaga atĩ kũrĩithia kĩrĩndĩ gwekĩkire hakuhĩ na Bethisaida (Luke 9:10). Kuuma karine ka kana, ageni a gũthathaiya nĩ maririkanaga ũndũ ũcio kũu Tabgha, kũrĩa mbica ĩrĩa ĩmenyekaine mũno ya mĩgate na thamaki ĩrĩ mbere ya kĩgongona.
The Phoenician coast north of Galilee, t: Hũgũrũrũ cia Foinike mwena wa rũgongo wa Galili; rũgendo o rũmwe Mwathani witũ aathiire nja ya bũrũri wa Isiraeli hĩndĩ ya wĩra wake.
Hippos (Sussita), above the eastern shor: Hippos (Sussita), igũrũ rĩa hũgũrũrũ cia irathĩro
Mark says He went \"into the district of: Mariko oigaga atĩ aahĩtũkĩire "gatagatĩ ka bũrũri wa Dekapoli" (Mark 7:31), ngwatanĩro ya matũũra ma Ngiriki mwena wa irathĩro wa iria. Gũtiugĩtwo kũndũ kũrĩa kũna ciama icio ciekĩkire; Hippos, itũũra rĩa Dekapoli rĩrĩa rĩrĩ hakuhĩ mũno na iria, nĩrĩo rĩrũgamĩrĩire bũrũri ũcio haha.
Matthew writes Magadan, Mark Dalmanutha: Mathayo aandĩkaga Magadani, Mariko Dalimanutha (Mark 8:10). Andũ aingĩ moonaga atĩ nĩ Magdala, itũũra rĩa Mũtheru Maria Magidalena, kũrĩa kwonirwo thunagogi ya karine ka mbere.
Bethsaida, north of the Sea of Galilee: Bethisaida, rũgongo rwa Iria rĩa Galili
The home of Peter, Andrew and Philip (Jo: Itũũra rĩa Petero, Anderea na Filipu (John 1:44). Athuthurie a maũndũ ma tene matiiguanĩte gatagatĩ ka Et-Tell na El-Araj, hakuhĩ na harĩa Jorodani ĩtoonyaga iria-inĩ.
Banias, at the foot of Mount Hermon: Banias, magũrũ-inĩ ma kĩrĩma kĩa Herimoni
A pagan city at the springs of the Jorda: Itũũra rĩa andũ a ndũrĩrĩ ithima-inĩ cia Jorodani, rungu rwa rũthingo rũnene rwa rwaro. Haha, mbere ya hekarũ cia ngai ya mũhianano Pan, Petero nĩ oimbũrire atĩ Jesũ nĩwe Kristo.
Basilica of the Transfiguration, Mount T: Basilika ya Kũgarũrũka, kĩrĩma kĩa Taboro
The Gospels say \"a high mountain\" (Mar: Ivanjeli ciugaga "kĩrĩma kĩraihu" (Mark 9:2). Kuuma hĩndĩ ya Origen na Mũtheru Cyril wa Jerusalemu, kĩrĩra kiugaga nĩ Taboro; basilika ya Afransiskani nĩ ĩthaithagia kĩongo gĩakĩo.
A town of black basalt in the hills abov: Itũũra rĩa mahiga marĩ meirũ tũrĩma-inĩ igũrũ rĩa Kapernaumu, kũmwe kwa kũrĩa "eekĩte ciama ciake nyingĩ" (Matthew 11:20-21).
The village of Martha, Mary and Lazarus: Itũũra rĩa Maritha, Maria na Lazaro mwena ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ. Kũu, ageni a gũthathaiya nĩ maceeragĩra mbĩrĩra ya Lazaro na kanitha wa Afransiskani.
The pool at the south end of the City of: Karia kĩhinga-inĩ gĩa gũthini kĩa Itũũra rĩa Daudi, karĩa kahe maaĩ nĩ mũtaro wa Hezekia. Ngathĩ ciako cia karine ka mbere nĩ cionirwo mwaka wa 2004.
Church of the Pater Noster (Eleona), Mou: Kanitha wa Baba Witũ (Eleona), Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
Saint Helena built the Eleona church ove: Mũtheru Helena nĩ aakire kanitha wa Eleona igũrũ rĩa ngurunga ĩrĩa, kũringana na kĩrĩra, Mwathani witũ aarutaga arutwo ake. Mahooya ma Baba Witũ nĩ mathaithagia thingo ciaguo na mĩario ĩkĩrĩte 140.
John says only that it was a town near t: Johana oigaga o atĩ warĩ itũũra hakuhĩ na werũ (John 11:54). Kĩrĩra nĩ kĩrĩigaga Taybeh, ũmũthĩ itũũra rĩa Akristiano.
The oasis city on the road up to Jerusal: Itũũra rĩa kũndũ kũrĩ maaĩ werũ-inĩ njĩra-inĩ ĩrĩa yambataga Jerusalemu. Mũkũyũ wa mũthikamore itũũra-inĩ nĩ ũtũririkanagia Zakayo.
Franciscan church of Bethphage, Mount of: Kanitha wa Afransiskani wa Bethifage, Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
The village where the disciples found th: Itũũra rĩrĩa arutwo moonire kana ka ndigiri. Mũtũarano wa Kiumia gĩa Mathangũ ma Mĩtende wa Kanitha wa Jerusalemu o na rĩu nĩ wambagĩrĩria kũu o mwaka.
Church of Dominus Flevit, Mount of Olive: Kanitha wa Dominus Flevit ("Mwathani nĩ aarĩrire"), Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
A small church shaped like a teardrop, l: Kanitha mũnini ũhaana ta ithori, ũrorete itũũra mũrĩmo wa gĩtuamba kĩa Kedironi, ũgatũririkania harĩa "Mwathani aarĩrĩire".
The early Church honoured Mount Zion as: Kanitha wa mbere nĩ watĩĩte kĩrĩma kĩa Zayuni ta harĩa Irio cia Hwaĩ-inĩ cia Mũthia na Pentekoste ciekĩkĩire. Nyũmba ya ũmũthĩ ya mũthemba wa Gothic yumĩte hĩndĩ ya Akurusedi na Afransiskani.
Church of All Nations, at the foot of th: Basilika ya Ndũrĩrĩ Ciothe, magũrũ-inĩ ma Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
The garden of ancient olive trees, with: Mũgũnda wa mĩtamaiyũ ya tene, hamwe na Basilika ya Ndũrĩrĩ Ciothe ĩrĩa yakirwo igũrũ rĩa ihiga rĩrĩa Mwathani witũ aahooire arĩ thĩinĩ wa ruo rũnene.
Saint Peter in Gallicantu, Mount Zion: Mũtheru Petero kũu Gallicantu, Kĩrĩma kĩa Zayuni
The Church of Saint Peter in Gallicantu: Kanitha wa Mũtheru Petero kũu Gallicantu ("rĩrĩa ngũkũ yagĩkũgĩte") nĩ ũtũririkanagia ũrega wa Petero na ũtukũ ũrĩa Mwathani witũ aarĩ njeera. Angĩ nĩ maigaga nyũmba ya mũthĩnjĩri-ngai mũnene hakuhĩ na Cenacolo.
Church of the Flagellation and Ecce Homo: Kanitha wa Kũhũũrwo Iboko na Kĩhingo kĩa Ecce Homo, Via Dolorosa
The Way of the Cross begins at the Anton: Njĩra ya Mũtharaba yambagĩrĩria Gĩtũũra-inĩ kĩa Ita kĩa Antonia, kũrĩa Afransiskani mamenyagĩrĩra makanitha ma Kũhũũrwo Iboko na ma Gũtuĩrwo Ciira. Athomi aingĩ nĩ maigaga Pilato nyũmba-inĩ ya ũnene ya Herode hakuhĩ na Kĩhingo kĩa Jafa.
The Way of the Cross, Old City of Jerusa: Njĩra ya Mũtharaba, Itũũra Inene rĩa Tene rĩa Jerusalemu
Since the Middle Ages pilgrims have pray: Kuuma Matukũ ma Gatagatĩ, ageni a gũthathaiya nĩ mahooyagĩra Ihinda cia Njĩra ya Mũtharaba barabara-inĩ ĩno, kuuma Gĩtũũra kĩa Ita kĩa Antonia nginya Kalvari; o Ijumaa Afransiskani nĩ matongoragia mũtũarano. Njĩra ya ma ĩrĩa Mwathani witũ aagererire ĩrũgamĩte harĩa Pilato aamũtuĩrĩire ciira.
Christians have honoured this place sinc: Akristiano nĩ matĩĩte kũndũ gũkũ kuuma njiarwa cia mbere; Mũtheru Helena na Konstantino nĩ maakire basilika igũrũ rĩa rwaro rwa Kalvari na mbĩrĩra ĩtarĩ kĩndũ, na ũmũthĩ Afransiskani nĩo matungataga kũu.
Luke gives the distance as about seven m: Luka oigaga ũraihu wa stadia mĩrongo ĩtandatũ kuuma Jerusalemu (Luke 24:13). Kũndũ gũtatũ nĩ gũtĩĩtwo: Emmaus Nicopolis, kũrĩa konanĩtio haha; El-Qubeibeh, kũrĩa kũmenyagĩrĩrwo nĩ Afransiskani; na Abu Ghosh.
Church of the Primacy of Saint Peter, Ta: Kanitha wa Wĩrugamĩrĩri wa Mũtheru Petero, Tabgha
A small basalt church on the water's edg: Kanitha mũnini wa mahiga marĩ meirũ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia maaĩ, ũrĩa wakirwo ũthiũrũrũkĩirie ihiga rĩĩtagwo "Mensa Christi" (Metha ya Kristo), harĩa, kũringana na kĩrĩra, aarugĩire Atũmwo irio cia rũciinĩ.
Church of the Sepulchre of Saint Mary, K: Kanitha wa Mbĩrĩra ya Maria, gĩtuamba kĩa Kedironi
Since at least the fifth century the Chu: Kuuma karine ka gatano kana mbere ya hĩndĩ ĩyo, Kanitha wa Jerusalemu nĩ ũtĩĩte mbĩrĩra ĩno magũrũ-inĩ ma Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ, hakuhĩ na Gethisemane, ta harĩa Nyina wa Ngai ambatirio igũrũ. Nyũmba ya amonaki ya Gũkoma kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Zayuni nĩ ĩririkanagia gũkoma gwake; kĩrĩra kĩngĩ kiugaga atĩ mĩaka yake ya mũthia aamĩikarire na Mũtheru Johana kũu Efeso.
Chapel of the Ascension, Mount of Olives: Kanitha Mũnini wa Kwambata Igũrũ, Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ
Luke says He led them \"as far as Bethan: Luka oigaga atĩ nĩ aamatongoririe "nginya Bethania" (Luke 24:50), na Atũmwo ikoigaga atĩ maacookire kuuma Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ (Acts 1:12). Kanitha mũnini kĩongo-inĩ nĩ ũigĩte ihiga rĩrĩa rĩtĩĩtwo ta rĩrĩ na makinya make ma mũthia.
The angel Gabriel greets the Virgin Mary: Mũraika Gaburieli nĩ ageithia Mũirĩtu ũrĩa ũiyũrĩtwo nĩ ngatho. Rĩrĩa acookia atĩrĩ "ũreke njĩkwo o ta ũrĩa woiga", Kiugo gĩgatuĩka mũndũ nda-inĩ yake.
Mary carries Our Lord to her kinswoman E: Maria nĩ akuuaga Mwathani witũ kwa mũrũ wa nyina Elizabethi. Johana nĩ athiũkaga nda-inĩ nĩ gĩkeno, Elizabethi amwĩtaga "Nyina wa Mwathani wakwa", na Maria akaina Magnificat.
Our Lord is born of the Virgin Mary in t: Itũũra-inĩ rĩa Daudi, Mwathani witũ aciarũo nĩ Mũirĩtu Theru Maria, akooherwo na nguo agakomio mũharatĩ-inĩ wa kũrĩĩra mahiũ, tondũ matiigana kuona handũ nyũmba-inĩ ya ageni.
An angel announces \"a savior who is Mes: Mũraika aanĩrĩra "Mũhonokia, ũrĩa nĩwe Kristo Mwathani", nacio mbũtũ cia igũrũ ikaina "Riiri nĩ ũrĩ wa Ngai kũrĩa igũrũ mũno". Arĩithi mahiũha gũthiĩ gũcaria Kaana.
Wise men from the East follow His star,: Andũ Oogĩ kuuma irathĩro marũmĩrĩra njata yake, makona Kaana hamwe na Maria nyina, na makamũhe thahabu, ũbumba wa kũnungĩra wega na manemane.
Mary and Joseph present the Child to the: Maria na Josefu maheana Mwathani Kaana. Simeoni amũkuua moko-inĩ make, amwĩta "ũtheri wa kũmũrĩkĩra ndũrĩrĩ", na eere Maria atĩ rũhiũ rwa njora nĩ rũgaatheeca ngoro yake.
Warned in a dream, Saint Joseph rises by: Atanaha mwĩhũgo kĩroto-inĩ, Mũtheru Josefu ookĩra ũtukũ akuua Kaana na nyina makĩthiĩ Misiri, kũraya na guoko kwa Herode, nĩguo kiugo kĩhinge: "Ndetire mũrũ wakwa oime Misiri" (Hosea 11:1).
After Herod's death the Holy Family sett: Herode aarĩkia gũkua, Nyũmba Theru ĩgĩtũũra Nazarethi, na "kaana kau gagĩkũra, gakĩgĩa na hinya, gakĩiyũrwo nĩ ũũgĩ, na ngatho ya Ngai ĩkĩgĩa igũrũ rĩako".
At twelve He stays behind in Jerusalem a: Arĩ wa mĩaka ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ, aatigwo Jerusalemu thutha wa Pasaka. Mũthenya wa gatatũ, Maria na Josefu mamuona gatagatĩ ka arutani: "Kaĩ mũtooĩ atĩ nĩ kwagĩrĩire nyikare maũndũ-inĩ ma Baba?"
For some thirty years He lives at Nazare: Ihinda rĩa ta mĩaka mĩrongo ĩtatũ aatũũraga Nazarethi, agĩathĩkĩra Maria na Josefu, akĩruta wĩra wa ũhiũ wa mbaũ, na agĩkũra ũũgĩ-inĩ, ũraihu-inĩ na ngatho-inĩ maitho-inĩ ma Ngai na andũ.
John baptizes Him in the Jordan. The hea: Johana nĩ aamũbatithirie Jorodani. Igũrũ rĩkĩhingũka, Roho Mũtheru agĩikũrũka ta ndutura, nayo mũgambo wa Ithe ũkiuga: "Ũyũ nĩwe Mũrũ wakwa nyendete, ũrĩa ngenagio nĩwe mũno."
Led by the Spirit into the desert, He fa: Roho amũtwara werũ-inĩ, kũrĩa eehingire kũrĩa mĩthenya mĩrongo ĩna na ũtukũ mĩrongo ĩna, na agĩtooria magerio ma mũcukani na Kiugo kĩa Ngai.
John points Him out: \"Behold, the Lamb: Johana amũonania: "Onai Gatũrũme ka Ngai." Anderea arehe mũrũ wa nyina Simoni, ũrĩa Jesũ eetire Kefa, ũguo nĩ kuuga Petero; Filipu na Nathanieli mamũrũmĩrĩra.
At His mother's word, \"Do whatever he t: Nĩ ũndũ wa kiugo kĩa Nyina, "Ĩkai ũndũ wothe ũrĩa arĩmwĩra", agarũra maaĩ magatuĩka ndibei, kĩmenyithia gĩake kĩa mbere, nao arutwo ake makĩambĩrĩria kũmwĩtĩkia.
To Jesus through Mary: Gũkinya kũrĩ Jesũ na njĩra ya Maria
The First Passover: Zeal for His Father': Pasaka ya mbere: kĩyo nĩ ũndũ wa nyũmba ya Ithe
He drives the money changers from the Te: Aingata agarũri a mbeca kuuma Hekarũ-inĩ na ũtukũ arute Nikodemo atĩ mũndũ no nginya aciarwo rĩngĩ na maaĩ na Roho. "Nĩgũkorwo Ngai nĩ eendire thĩ mũno, o nginya akĩheana Mũriũ wake ũrĩa wa mũmwe."
Weary at noon, He asks a Samaritan woman: Aanogete mũthenya barigici, eetia mũtumia Mũsamaria maaĩ ma kũnyua, nake amũhe maaĩ ma muoyo, "gĩthima kĩa maaĩ maratherera nginya muoyo wa tene na tene". Aingĩ a itũũra rĩake mamwĩtĩkia.
Healing the Official's Son: Kũhonia mũriũ wa mũnene wa mũthamaki
A royal official from Capernaum begs Him: Mũnene ũmwe wa mũthamaki kuuma Kapernaumu amũthaitha oke. "Thiĩ, mũrũguo nĩ muoyo." Ihinda-inĩ o rĩu kaana gakĩhona.
In the synagogue He reads Isaiah, \"The: Thunagogi-inĩ athoma ibuku-inĩ rĩa Isaia, "Roho wa Mwathani arĩ igũrũ rĩakwa", na akiuga: "Ũmũthĩ Maandĩko macio nĩ mahingĩte." Andũ a itũũra rĩake mamũtwara hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia kĩrĩma, no agĩtuĩkanĩria gatagatĩ-inĩ kao agĩthiĩ.
The Franciscans honour the Mount of the: Afransiskani nĩ matĩĩte Kĩrĩma kĩa Gũthiũka gũthini wa itũũra ta kĩrĩma kĩrĩa kiugĩtwo thĩinĩ wa Luke 4:29.
Leaving Nazareth, He makes His home in C: Aarĩkia kuuma Nazarethi, atũũra Kapernaumu hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia iria, na akĩambĩrĩria kũhunjia: "Ihinda nĩ rĩkinyĩte, Ũthamaki wa Ngai nĩ ũkuhĩrĩirie. Ĩrirai na mwĩtĩkie Ivanjeli."
By the shore He calls Simon and Andrew,: Hũgũrũrũ-inĩ eeta Simoni na Anderea, Jakubu na Johana: "Nũmĩrĩrai, na nĩngũmũtua ategi a andũ." Thutha wa kũgũra thamaki na njĩra ya kĩama, matiga maũndũ mothe makamũrũmĩrĩra.
He teaches with authority in the synagog: Arutana na ũhoti thunagogi-inĩ, aingata ngoma thĩinĩ wa mũndũ, arũgamia nyina wa mũtumia wa Petero kuuma mũrimũ-inĩ wa mwĩrũgũtho, na rĩrĩa riũa rĩathũa itũũra rĩothe rĩcemania mũromo-inĩ wa nyũmba.
The Paralytic and the Call of Matthew: Mũndũ mũkue mwĩrĩ na gwĩtwo kwa Mathayo
Friends lower a paralyzed man through th: Arata mekũrũkia mũndũ mũkue mwĩrĩ na njĩra ya nyũmba igũrũ; Jesũ amũrekere mehia make na amwathe athiĩ. Thutha ũcio eeta Lawi, Mathayo, harĩa ookanagĩrĩrio igooti: "Nũmĩrĩra."
He teaches the Beatitudes, \"Blessed are: Arute Irathimo, "Kũrathimwo nĩ arĩa athĩĩni roho-inĩ, tondũ Ũthamaki wa igũrũ nĩ wao", watho mwerũ wa wendo, na mahooya ma Baba Witũ.
The Centurion's Servant: Ndungata ya mũnene wa thigari igana
A Roman centurion says, \"Lord, I am not: Mũnene wa thigari igana Mũroma oiga atĩrĩ: "Mwathani, ndiagĩrĩirwo nĩ atĩ ũtoonye nyũmba yakwa, no ugo o kiugo kĩmwe." Kanitha nĩ ũcookagia ciugo ciake mbere ya kwamũkĩra Ũkaristia o Misa-inĩ.
Moved with pity for a widow burying her: Amũiguĩra tha mũtumia wa ndigwa ũrĩa warĩ gũthika mũriũ wake ũrĩa wa mũmwe, ahutia gĩtanda gĩa kĩimba: "Mwanake, ndakwĩra atĩrĩ, ũkĩra!" na akamũcookeria nyina.

A violent squall swamps the boat while H: Kĩhuhũkanio kĩnene kĩiyũria gĩtarũrũ maaĩ, nake akomete. Akaania rũhuho: "Kira! Hoorera!" na gũkĩgĩa na ũhooreri mũnene. "Ũyũ nĩ ũ, atĩ o na rũhuho na iria nĩ imwathĩkagĩra?"

A woman is healed by touching His cloak,: Mũtumia ũmwe ahona rĩrĩa ahutia nguo yake, nake anyiita guoko kwa mũirĩtu wa Jairo ũrĩa wakuĩte: "Talitha kumi", ũguo nĩ kuuga: "Kairĩtu, ndakwĩra atĩrĩ, ũkĩra!"
With five loaves and two fish He feeds t: Na mĩgate ĩtano na thamaki igĩrĩ arĩithia kĩrĩndĩ, aroraga igũrũ, agacookia ngaatho na akoinanga mĩgate, nao makĩũngania ikabũ ikũmi na igĩrĩ iyũrĩte tũcunjĩ tũrĩa twatigarire.
In the fourth watch of the night He come: Ihinda-inĩ rĩa mũthia rĩa ũtukũ ookire kũrĩ o agĩthiĩ igũrũ rĩa iria. Petero athiĩ kũmũtũnga, aambĩrĩria kũrũũra na akaanĩrĩra: "Mwathani, honokia!"

A Gentile mother begs Him to heal her da: Nyina ũmwe wa ndũrĩrĩ amũthaitha nĩ ũndũ wa mwarĩ: "O na ngui nĩ irĩĩaga tũcunjĩ tũrĩa tũgũaga kuuma metha-inĩ ya aathani ao." "Mũtumia, wĩtĩkio waku nĩ mũnene!"

He rides into Jerusalem on a colt as the: Atoonya Jerusalemu ahaicĩte kana ka ndigiri rĩrĩa kĩrĩndĩ kĩratambũrũkia nguo na honge: "Hosana kũrĩ Mũrũ wa Daudi! Nĩ mũrathime ũrĩa ũrooka na rĩĩtwa rĩa Mwathani!"

Seated on the Mount of Olives facing the: Aikarĩte Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ arorete Hekarũ, aaria ũhoro wa kwanangwo kwayo na ũhoro wa gũũka gwake arĩ na riiri: "Ũrĩa mwekire ũmwe wa ariũ a baba aya anini mũno, mwekire niĩ."
He washes His disciples' feet, and takin: Athambia magũrũ ma arutwo ake na, akĩoya mũgate na ndibei, akiuga: "Ũyũ nĩ mwĩrĩ wakwa… Gĩkombe gĩkĩ nĩ kĩrĩkanĩro kĩerũ thakame-inĩ yakwa… Ĩkagai ũguo nĩ ũndũ wa kũndirikana"; nĩ ũndũ ũcio aahe Kanitha Ũkaristia na ũthĩnjĩri-ngai.

He walks unrecognized with two disciples: Matamũmenyete, athiĩ na arutwo eerĩ na akamataarĩria Maandĩko, nao makamũmenya rĩrĩa oinanga mũgate. "Githĩ ngoro citũ ndiahĩaga thĩinĩ witũ?"

Pope Saint Pius V, himself a Dominican,: Mũtheru Papa Pio V, o nake Mũdominika, nĩ aaheire Rosari mũhianĩre wayo wa hĩndĩ ciothe wa maũndũ ma hitho ikũmi na ithano, ma Gĩkeno, ma Ruo na ma Riiri, mwaka wa 1569. Kũu Lourdes na Fatima, Mũirĩtu Theru we mwene ookire na rosari na akĩũria ĩhooyagwo o mũthenya.
On October 16, 2002, Pope Saint John Pau: Mũthenya wa 16 mweri wa Ikũmi 2002, Mũtheru Papa Johana Paulo II nĩ ongereire maũndũ ma hitho matano ma Ũtheri, kuuma mũtũũrĩre-inĩ wa Mwathani witũ wa kĩrĩndĩ-inĩ, marũa-inĩ make ma atũmwo Rosarium Virginis Mariae, nĩguo Rosari ĩtuĩke "ũhoro mũkuhĩ wa Ivanjeli". Divided after Solomon into the northern: Thuutha wa Solomoni wagayũkanirie: ũthamaki wa Isiraeli mwena wa rũgongo na ũthamaki wa Juda mwena wa mũhuro (1 Kings 12:16-20).
In Jesus' time the regions were Judea, S: Hĩndĩ ya Jesũ mabũrũri maguo maarĩ Judea, Samaria na Galili (Luke 17:11; John 4:3-4). Rĩĩtwa Palestina rĩumĩte Filistia, bũrũri wa Afilisti (Exodus 15:14).
The Book of Judith is set in Bethulia, a: Ibuku rĩa Juditha rĩrĩ Bethulia, itũũra inene rĩa Samaria rĩtooĩkaine harĩa rĩarĩ (Judith 4:6; Judith 6:10-11).
The Maccabees fought here for the freedo: Haha nĩ ho Amakabayo maarũĩrĩire wĩyathi wa kũrũmia watho wa Ngai, na makĩgarũra Hekarũ (1 Maccabees 2-4).
Since 1342 the Franciscans of the Custod: Kuuma mwaka wa 1342, Afransisikani a Ũrũgamĩrĩri wa Bũrũri Mũtheru nĩo marũgamagĩrĩra handũ hatheru handũ ha Kanitha Katholiki.
The Latin Patriarchate of Jerusalem serv: Mũpatriaki wa Kilatini wa Jerusalemu nĩ atungataga Akatholiki a Isiraeli, Palestina, Jorodani na Kuporo, hamwe na ikundi cia Makanitha Katholiki ma Irathĩro: Amelkiti, Amaroni, Asuriani, Aarmenia na angĩ.
Popes Paul VI (1964), John Paul II (2000: Mapapa Paulo wa Gatandatũ (1964), Johana Paulo wa Kerĩ (2000), Benedikto wa Ikũmi na Gatandatũ (2009) na Fransisko (2014) othe nĩ maathiire rũgendo rũtheru gũkũ.
Modern Iran was the heart of the Persian: Iran ya ũmũthĩ nĩyo yarĩ gatagatĩ ka Ũthamaki wa Perisia. Mũthamaki wayo Kurusu ũrĩa Mũnene nĩetĩkĩririe Ayahudi macooke kuuma ũkombo-inĩ wa Babuloni, na mabuku ma Esiteri, Tobiti na Juditha marĩ gĩcigo-inĩ gĩkĩ.
Isaiah calls Cyrus, a pagan king, the Lo: Isaia eetaga Kurusu, mũthamaki ũtaarĩ Mũyahudi, “mũitĩrĩrie maguta” wa Mwathani, ũrĩa wathuurirwo kuohora andũ arĩa maarĩ ũkombo-inĩ (Isaiah 44:28; Isaiah 45:1-4).
Cyrus's decree lets the Jews go home and: Watho wa Kurusu nĩwetĩkĩririe Ayahudi macooke mũciĩ na maake rĩngĩ Hekarũ Jerusalemu (Ezra 1:1-4; 2 Chronicles 36:22-23). Kobĩ yaguo yonekire thuutha Ekbatana (Ezra 6:1-5).
Esther, a Jewish queen at the Persian co: Esiteri, mũtumia wa mũthamaki Mũyahudi nyũmba-inĩ ya ũthamaki ya Perisia kũu Susa, nĩaigire muoyo wake ũgwati-inĩ nĩguo ahonokie andũ ake; ũguo nĩguo gĩathĩ gĩa Purimu kĩambĩrĩirie (Esther 4:14; Esther 9:20-32). Mabibilia ma Akatholiki marĩ na icunjĩ cia Kĩngiriki cia Esiteri, hamwe na mahoya ma Moridekai na Esiteri.
Nehemiah is cupbearer to King Artaxerxes: Nehemia aarĩ mũheani wa kĩnyuaro kĩa Mũthamaki Aritashashita kũu Susa atanathiĩ kwaka rĩngĩ thingo cia Jerusalemu (Nehemiah 1:1; Nehemiah 2:1-8).
Daniel sees a vision at Susa, by the riv: Danieli nĩonire cioneki kũu Susa, hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia rũũĩ rwa Ulai (Daniel 8:2).
Israelites taken by Assyria were settled: Aisiraeli arĩa maatwarirwo ũkombo-inĩ nĩ Ashuri maaigirwo “matũũra-inĩ ma Amedi” (2 Kings 17:6). Ũyũ nĩguo bũrũri wa Tobiti: mũriũ wake Tobia nĩathiire na mũraika Rafaeli nginya Ekbatana na Rage kũu Media (Tobit 1:14; Tobit 3:7).
The Book of Judith opens with Arphaxad,: Ibuku rĩa Juditha rĩambagĩrĩria na Arifakisadi, mũthamaki wa Amedi, ũrĩa wakire thingo cia Ekbatana (Judith 1:1-4).
Elam, in the south-west, appears from Ab: Elamu wa mwena wa mũhuro ithũĩro nĩ wĩtagwo kuuma hĩndĩ ya Iburahĩmu (Genesis 14:1) nginya kũrĩ anabii (Jeremiah 49:34-39).
Parthians, Medes and Elamites heard the: Mũthenya wa Pentekoste, Aparithia, Amedi na Aelamu nĩmaiguire atũmwo makĩaria na thiomi ciao (Acts 2:9).
The Magi 'from the east' (Matthew 2:1) b: Andũ oogĩ “kuuma Irathĩro” (Matthew 2:1) marĩ na rĩĩtwa rĩa athĩnjĩri-Ngai a Perisia. Ũhoro wa thuutha ugaga atharĩkĩri a Perisia matiaanangire Kanitha Mũnene wa Gũciarwo kũu Bethilehemu mwaka wa 614, tondũ mbica yaguo yonanagia andũ oogĩ mehumbĩte nguo cia Perisia.
Local tradition honours the tomb of the: Mũtugo wa andũ a kũu nĩ ũtĩĩaga mbĩrĩra ya mũnabii Danieli kũu Shush (Susa wa tene), na ya Esiteri na Moridekai kũu Hamadan (Ekbatana wa tene).
Catholics in Iran today belong to the Ch: Ũmũthĩ Akatholiki a Iran marĩ a Makanitha ma Akaldayo, Aarmenia na ma Kilatini (Tehran-Isfahan).
The land between the Tigris and Euphrate: Bũrũri ũrĩ gatagatĩ ka Tigiri na Farati. Iburahĩmu oimire Uru, Jona akĩhunjia Nineve, na Ayahudi magĩikara ũkombo-inĩ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia njũũĩ cia Babuloni.
The Tigris and Euphrates are named among: Tigiri na Farati nĩ njũũĩ igĩrĩ thĩinĩ wa njũũĩ inya cia Edeni (Genesis 2:10-14).
The tower of Babel is built in 'the land: Mũthiringo mũraihu wa Babeli waakirwo “bũrũri-inĩ wa Shinari” (Genesis 11:1-9).
Abram's family leaves Ur of the Chaldean: Nyũmba ya Aburamu yoimire Uru wa Akaldayo (Genesis 11:31; Genesis 15:7).
Assyria, ruled from Nineveh, destroys th: Ashuri, arĩa maathanaga kuuma Nineve, nĩmaanangire ũthamaki wa rũgongo wa Isiraeli mwaka wa 722 mbere ya Kristo (2 Kings 17:5-6). Babuloni nĩyanangire Jerusalemu mwaka wa 587 mbere ya Kristo (2 Kings 25:8-11).
The exiles weep 'by the rivers of Babylo: Andũ a ũkombo-inĩ nĩmaarĩrire “hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia njũũĩ cia Babuloni” (Psalm 137). Ezekieli nĩonire cioneki hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia rũũĩ rwa Kebaru (Ezekiel 1:1-3).
Tobit is a captive in Nineveh who buries: Tobiti aarĩ mũkombo kũu Nineve ũrĩa wathikaga akuũ o na gũtuĩka nĩ kwaigaga muoyo wake ũgwati-inĩ (Tobit 1:3; Tobit 1:17-20).
Baruch, Jeremiah's scribe, reads his boo: Baruku, mwandĩki wa Jeremia, nĩathomeire andũ a ũkombo-inĩ kũu Babuloni ibuku rĩake (Baruch 1:1-4).
People from Mesopotamia heard the Gospel: Andũ kuuma Mesopotamia nĩmaiguire Ũhoro Mwega mũthenya wa Pentekoste (Acts 2:9).
Tradition says the apostle Thomas and hi: Kũringana na mũtugo, Ũhoro Mwega warehirwo gũkũ nĩ mũtũmwo Toma na arutwo ake Addai na Mari. Kanitha Katholiki wa Akaldayo, ũrĩa Mũpatriaki waguo arĩ Baghdad, ũhooyaga na Liturgia ĩrĩa wagaĩire kuuma Kanitha-inĩ ũyũ wa tene wa Irathĩro.
Many Christians of the Nineveh Plains, i: Akristiano aingĩ a werũ wa Nineve, hamwe na Akatholiki Asuriani a Qaraqosh, nĩmaingatirwo nĩ Bũrũri wa Ũislamu mwaka wa 2014.
Pope Francis made the first papal visit: Mweri wa Gatatũ 2021, Papa Fransisko nĩathiire rũgendo rwa mbere rwa Papa Iraq, akĩhooya kũu Uru, Mosul na Qaraqosh.
Egypt was a place of refuge and of slave: Misiri nĩ bũrũri wa kũũrĩra na wa ũkombo: kũrĩa Jusufu aagĩire na hinya, kũrĩa Isiraeli yatuĩkire ngombo na ĩkĩohorwo Ũmaruo-inĩ, na kũrĩa Nyũmba Theru yorĩire Herode.
Abram goes down to Egypt in a famine (Ge: Aburamu nĩaikũrũkire Misiri nĩ ũndũ wa ng'aragu (Genesis 12:10-20).
Joseph, sold by his brothers, becomes Ph: Jusufu, ũrĩa aariũ a ithe maamwendirie, nĩatuĩkire mũrori wa nyũmba ya Firaũni, nayo nyũmba ya Jakubu ĩgĩikara Gosheni (Genesis 41:41-45; Genesis 47:27).
Israel is enslaved, building the store c: Isiraeli yatuĩkire ngombo ĩgĩaka matũũra ma kũiga indo Pithomu na Ramesesi (Exodus 1:8-14). Ngai nĩamahonoririe na njĩra ya Musa na kũringa Iria Itune (Exodus 12-14).
Isaiah foresees an altar to the Lord in: Isaia nĩarathire kĩgongona kĩa Mwathani thĩinĩ wa Misiri, Ngai akiuga: “Misiri, andũ akwa, rogathimwo” (Isaiah 19:19-25).
Joseph, Mary and the child Jesus flee to: Jusufu, Maria na Kaana Jesũ nĩmorĩire Misiri gwĩtiiria Herode, nĩguo kiugo kĩhinge: “Nĩndetire Mũriũ wakwa oime Misiri” (Matthew 2:13-15; Hosea 11:1).
Ben Sira's grandson translated the Book: Mwana wa mwana wa Ben Sira nĩagarũrire ibuku rĩa Siraki na Kĩngiriki rĩrĩa aakinyire Misiri (Sirach, kiugo kĩa mbere). Kĩrĩkanĩro Gĩkũrũ na Kĩngiriki, Septuaginta, gĩathondekirwo Alekisandiria na kĩrĩ na mabuku marĩa Akatholiki meetaga Deuterokanoniki.
Tradition names St Mark the Evangelist a: Mũtugo nĩ wĩtĩkagia Mũtheru Mariko Mwandĩki wa Ũhoro Mwega nĩwe wambĩrĩirie Kanitha wa Alekisandiria.
Christian monastic life began in the Egy: Muoyo wa amonaki Akristiano wambĩrĩirie werũ-inĩ wa Misiri na Mũtheru Antoni Abbate na Maithe ma Werũ-inĩ.
The Coptic Catholic Church is based in C: Kanitha Katholiki wa Akopti ũrĩ na mũciĩ waguo mũnene Kairo. Mũtugo wa Akopti ũrũmagĩrĩra njĩra ya Nyũmba Theru Misiri, hamwe na ngurunga ĩrĩa ĩrĩ rungu rwa kanitha wa Atheru Serigio na Bako kũu Kairo wa Tene.
St John Paul II visited Mount Sinai in 2: Mũtheru Johana Paulo wa Kerĩ nĩathiire kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Sinai mwaka wa 2000, na Papa Fransisko agĩceerera Misiri mwaka wa 2017.
East of the Jordan River lay Moab, Ammon: Mwena wa irathĩro wa Jorodani nĩ kũrĩ Moabi, Amoni, Edomu na Gileadi. Haha, Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Nebo, Musa nĩ ho onire Bũrũri wa Kĩĩranĩro; Ruthu aarĩ Mũmoabi, na Johana nĩabatithagia “mũringo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Jorodani”.
Jacob wrestles with God at the ford of t: Jakubu nĩagũthanire na Ngai iringĩro-inĩ rĩa Jaboku, na akĩheo rĩĩtwa Isiraeli (Genesis 32).
Moses views the Promised Land from Mount: Musa nĩarorire Bũrũri wa Kĩĩranĩro arĩ Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Nebo, na agĩkuĩra Moabi (Deuteronomy 34:1-6).
Ruth the Moabite, ancestor of David and: Ruthu Mũmoabi, cũcũ wa Daudi na wa Jesũ, nĩathuurire Ngai wa Naomi (Ruth 1:16; Matthew 1:5).
Elijah came from Tishbe in Gilead (1 Kin: Elija aarĩ Mũtishibi wa Gileadi (1 Kings 17:1). Uria nĩakuĩrĩire kũrigiicĩrio-inĩ kwa Raba wa Aamoni, Amman ya ũmũthĩ (2 Samuel 11:1-17).
Judas Maccabeus campaigns in Gilead to r: Juda Makabayo nĩatongoririe ita nginya Gileadi kũhonokia Ayahudi arĩa maatũũraga kuo (1 Maccabees 5:9-54).
John baptizes at 'Bethany across the Jor: Johana nĩabatithagia “Bethania mũringo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Jorodani” (John 1:28). Jesũ nĩahĩtũkire Dekapoli (Mark 7:31).
The Jewish historian Josephus says John: Kũringana na mwandĩki wa ũhoro wa tene Mũyahudi Flavio Josephu, Johana Mũbatithania nĩatinirio mũtwe kĩgo-inĩ kĩa Herode kĩa Makaerusi, mwena wa irathĩro wa Iria rĩa Cumbĩ (rora Mark 6:17-29).
The baptism site at Bethany beyond the J: Handũ ha ũbatithio Bethania mũringo ũrĩa ũngĩ wa Jorodani nĩ haceereirwo nĩ Mapapa Johana Paulo wa Kerĩ, Benedikto wa Ikũmi na Gatandatũ na Fransisko.
The Marian shrine of Our Lady of the Mou: Handũ hatheru ha Maitũ Witũ wa Kĩrĩma kũu Anjar nĩ haririkanagia mũtugo atĩ Jesũ, Maria na arutwo nĩmahurũkire gũkũ ngurunga-inĩ.
Ancient Aram, Israel's northern neighbou: Aramu wa tene, mũtũũrania wa rũgongo wa Isiraeli. Saulo wa Tariso nĩacemanirie na Kristo Ũrĩa Wariũkire njĩra-inĩ ya Dameski, na hĩndĩ ya Jesũ Suria wa Aroma nĩwakinyaga nginya Antiokia.
Abraham's servant was Eliezer of Damascu: Ndungata ya Iburahĩmu yarĩ Eliezeri wa Dameski (Genesis 15:2).
Naaman, an Aramean general, is healed of: Naamani, mũnene wa ita Mũaramu, nĩethambire Jorodani kũringana na kiugo kĩa Elisha, na akĩhona mangũ (2 Kings 5:1-14).
Jesus' fame 'spread to all of Syria' (Ma: Ngumo ya Jesũ “nĩyahurunjũkire Suria guothe” (Matthew 4:24). Kirenio aarĩ ngavana wa Suria rĩrĩa Jesũ aaciarirwo (Luke 2:2).
Saul is blinded by the light of Christ o: Njĩra-inĩ ya Dameski, Saulo nĩatuĩkire mũtumumu nĩ ũndũ wa ũtheri wa Kristo, na akĩbatithio itũũra-inĩ inene (Acts 9:1-19).
Villages such as Maaloula still speak a: Matũũra-inĩ ta Maalula andũ no maragia Kĩaramu, rũthiomi rũrĩa Jesũ aaragia.
The Melkite Greek Catholic Patriarch has: Mũpatriaki wa Kanitha Katholiki wa Amelkiti a Kĩngiriki arĩ Dameski. Suria ĩrĩ na Akatholiki Asuriani, Amaroni, Aarmenia na a Kilatini.
St John Paul II prayed at the shrine of: Mũtheru Johana Paulo wa Kerĩ nĩahooire mwaka wa 2001 mbĩrĩra-inĩ ya Mũtheru Johana Mũbatithania thĩinĩ wa Mosque ya Aumayyadi kũu Dameski; nĩwe Papa wa mbere gũtoonya mosque.
The coast of the Phoenicians, whose ceda: Hũgũrũrũ cia iria cia Afoinike, arĩa mĩtarakwa yao yahũthĩrirwo Hekarũ-inĩ ya Solomoni. Jesũ nĩathiire mabũrũri ma Turo na Sidoni, nake Elija agĩikara na mũtumia wa ndigwa kũu Sarefathu.
King Hiram of Tyre sends cedars of Leban: Hiramu, mũthamaki wa Turo, nĩatũmire mĩtarakwa ya Lebanoni ya gwaka Hekarũ ya Solomoni (1 Kings 5).
Elijah is fed by the widow of Zarephath: Elija nĩaheirwo irio nĩ mũtumia wa ndigwa wa Sarefathu, na akĩriũkia mũriũ wake (1 Kings 17:8-24; Luke 4:25-26).
The Psalms and the Song of Songs praise: Thaburi na Rwĩmbo rwa Nyĩmbo nĩ ikumagia mĩtarakwa na mũrĩo mwega wa Lebanoni (Psalm 104:16; Song of Songs 4:8-15).
Jesus heals the daughter of a Syrophoeni: Jesũ nĩahonirie mwarĩ wa mũtumia Mũsirofoinike mabũrũri-inĩ ma Turo (Mark 7:24-30).
Lebanon is home of the Maronite Catholic: Lebanoni nĩ mũciĩ wa Kanitha Katholiki wa Amaroni, ũrĩa Mũpatriaki waguo arĩ Bkerke, na wa Akatholiki Amelkiti, Asuriani na Aarmenia.
The Kadisha Valley, the 'Holy Valley' be: Mũkuru wa Qadisha, “Mũkuru Mũtheru” rungu rwa Mĩtarakwa ya Ngai, warĩ kĩũrĩro kĩa andũ meyamũrĩte na mũciĩ wa amonaki Amaroni mĩaka magana maingĩ.
Lebanese saints include St Charbel Makhl: Thĩinĩ wa atheru a Lebanoni nĩ harĩ Mũtheru Sharbel Makhlouf, Mũtheru Rafqa na Mũtheru Nimatullah al-Hardini.
More New Testament places lie in Turkey: Turkey ĩrĩ na handũ haingĩ ha Kĩrĩkanĩro Kĩerũ gũkĩra bũrũri ũngĩ o wothe tiga Bũrũri Mũtheru: Tariso kũrĩa Paulo aaciarĩirwo, Antiokia, Efeso, Makanitha ma Galatia na Makanitha mũgwanja ma Kũguũrĩrio.
Noah's ark comes to rest 'on the mountai: Ithanwa rĩa Nuhu rĩarũgamire “irĩma-inĩ cia Ararati” (Genesis 8:4).
Paul is born at Tarsus in Cilicia (Acts: Paulo aaciarĩirwo Tariso kũu Kilikia (Acts 22:3). Antiokia nĩkuo arutwo maambĩrĩirie gwĩtwo Akristiano (Acts 11:26).
Paul's journeys take him through Pisidia: Ngendo cia Paulo nĩciamũkinyirie Antiokia ya Pisidia, Ikonio, Lusitira na Derube (Acts 13-14), na akĩandĩkĩra Agalatia (Galatians 1:2).
1 Peter is addressed to Christians in Po: Marũa ma mbere ma Petero maandĩkĩirwo Akristiano a Ponto, Galatia, Kapadokia, Asia na Bithinia (1 Peter 1:1).
Revelation is written to seven churches: Kũguũrĩrio kwandĩkĩirwo Makanitha mũgwanja ma Asia: Efeso, Simurina, Perigamo, Thuatira, Saridi, Filadelfia na Laodikia (Revelation 1:11).
The first ecumenical councils, at Nicaea: Mĩcemanio mĩnene ya mbere ya Kanitha yarĩ Nikaia (325), Konstantinopoli (381), Efeso (431) na Kalkedoni (451), thĩinĩ wa Turkey ya ũmũthĩ.
Tradition holds that St John brought the: Kũringana na mũtugo, Mũtheru Johana nĩatwarire Mũirĩtu Maria nginya Efeso (John 19:27).
St John XXIII served in Istanbul as the: Mũtheru Johana wa Mĩrongo Ĩĩrĩ na Ithatũ nĩatungatire ta mũtũmwo wa Papa kũu Istanbul kuuma 1935 nginya 1944. Ikundi nini cia Akatholiki a Kilatini, Aarmenia, Akaldayo na Asuriani no irĩ ho.
Paul first brought the Gospel to Europe: Haha nĩ ho Paulo aambĩrĩirie kũrehe Ũhoro Mwega Ũroba, Filipi, thuutha Thesalonike, Athene na Korintho. Kĩrĩkanĩro Kĩerũ kĩo kĩene kĩandĩkirwo na Kĩngiriki.
Daniel's vision of the goat stands for ': Kĩoneki-inĩ kĩa Danieli, thenge nĩyo “mũthamaki wa Ngiriki”, Alekisanda ũrĩa Mũnene (Daniel 8:21). Ibuku rĩa mbere rĩa Amakabayo rĩambagĩrĩria na ũhootani wa Alekisanda (1 Maccabees 1:1-9).
Jonathan Maccabeus writes to the Spartan: Jonathani Makabayo nĩaandĩkĩire Asiparita nĩguo macookerie ũrata (1 Maccabees 12:1-23).
In a vision a Macedonian begs Paul, 'Com: Kĩoneki-inĩ, mũndũ wa Makedonia nĩathaithire Paulo akiuga: “Ringa ũũke Makedonia ũtũteithie!” (Acts 16:9).
Paul founds churches at Philippi, Thessa: Paulo nĩambĩrĩirie Makanitha Filipi, Thesalonike, Beroya na Korintho, na akĩhunjia Athene (Acts 16-18).
John receives the Book of Revelation on: Johana nĩamũkĩrire Kũguũrĩrio gĩcigĩrĩra-inĩ kĩa Patimo (Revelation 1:9).
Sts Cyril and Methodius, apostles to the: Atheru Kurilo na Methodio, atũmwo a Aslavi na arũgamĩrĩri a Ũroba, maaciarĩirwo Thesalonike.
St John Paul II visited the Areopagus in: Mũtheru Johana Paulo wa Kerĩ nĩaceereire mwaka wa 2001 Areopago kũu Athene, kũrĩa Paulo aahunjirie.
Greece has small Latin and Greek Byzanti: Ngiriki ĩrĩ na ikundi nini cia Akatholiki a Kilatini na a mũtugo wa Kĩngiriki-Bizanti. Kanitha Mũnene Katholiki wa Athene nĩ waamũrĩirwo Mũtheru Dionisio wa Areopago, ũrĩa Paulo aagarũrire (Acts 17:34).
Rome, capital of the empire, received Pa: Roma, itũũra inene rĩa ũthamaki, nĩrĩamũkĩrire Paulo ta mũohe; kũringana na mũtugo wa tene, Petero na Paulo nĩmaakuĩrĩire gũkũ ta aira a wĩtĩkio. Papa, mũcookereri wa Petero, no aikaraga gũkũ.
Judas Maccabeus makes a treaty of friend: Juda Makabayo nĩathondekire kĩrĩkanĩro kĩa ũrata na Aroma (1 Maccabees 8:17-32).
Visitors from Rome are in Jerusalem at P: Mũthenya wa Pentekoste nĩ kwarĩ ageni moimĩte Roma thĩinĩ wa Jerusalemu (Acts 2:10).
Paul writes his Letter to the Romans bef: Paulo nĩaandĩkĩire Aroma atanakinya (Romans 1:7-15), thuutha, arĩ mũohe, agĩkinya Regio na Puteoli rĩrĩa aathiiaga Roma (Acts 28:13-16).
Hebrews sends greetings from 'those from: Marũa kũrĩ Ahibirania nĩmatũmaga ngeithi kuuma kũrĩ “arĩa marĩ Italia” (Hebrews 13:24).
Tradition holds that Peter was crucified: Kũringana na mũtugo, Petero nĩambirwo kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Vatikani, nake Paulo agĩtinio mũtwe nja ya thingo njĩra-inĩ ya Ostia, ta mwaka wa 64-67, hĩndĩ ya Nero.
St Peter's Basilica stands over Peter's: Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũtheru Petero ũrũgamĩte igũrũ rĩa mbĩrĩra ya Petero, na Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũtheru Paulo Nja ya Thingo igũrũ rĩa mbĩrĩra ya Paulo.
Vatican City, inside Rome, is the seat o: Bũrũri wa Itũũra Inene rĩa Vatikani, ũrĩa ũrĩ thĩinĩ wa Roma, nĩ mũciĩ wa Papa.
The island where Paul was shipwrecked on: Gĩcigĩrĩra kũrĩa ngarĩ ya maaĩ ya Paulo yoinĩkĩire rĩrĩa aathiiaga Roma. Nĩahonokire kũrũmwo nĩ nyoka, na akĩhonia ithe wa Publio, mũnene wa gĩcigĩrĩra.
The ship carrying Paul runs aground and: Ngarĩ ya maaĩ ĩrĩa yakuuĩte Paulo nĩyarũgamire mũthanga-inĩ, na andũ othe 276 arĩa maarĩ thĩinĩ wayo magĩkinya thĩ nyũmũ marĩ muoyo (Acts 27:37-44).
The islanders show 'extraordinary kindne: Andũ a gĩcigĩrĩra nĩmaaonanirie “ũtugi ũtarĩ wa ndũire”. Nyoka nĩyarũmire Paulo, no ndaagĩire na ũũru (Acts 28:1-6).
Paul heals Publius's father and many oth: Paulo nĩahonirie ithe wa Publio na angĩ aingĩ, na agĩikara kuo mĩeri ĩtatũ (Acts 28:7-11).
Malta keeps 10 February, the Feast of St: Malta nĩ ĩkũngũyagĩra mũthenya wa 10 mweri wa Kerĩ Gĩathĩ kĩa Kuuna kwa Ngarĩ ya Maaĩ ya Mũtheru Paulo ta mũthenya mũnene wa bũrũri.
Tradition makes Publius the first bishop: Mũtugo nĩ wĩtĩkagia Publio nĩwe Mbishobu wa mbere wa Malta. Mapapa Johana Paulo wa Kerĩ, Benedikto wa Ikũmi na Gatandatũ na Fransisko nĩmaahooire Ngurunga-inĩ ya Mũtheru Paulo kũu Rabat.
Home of Barnabas and the first stop of P: Bũrũri wa Barinaba na handũ ha mbere ha rũgendo rwa mbere rwa ũmisheni rwa Paulo, kũrĩa ngavana Mũroma Serigio Paulo eetĩkirie.
Kittim, linked with Cyprus, appears amon: Kitimu, kĩrĩa kĩnyitithanagio na Kuporo, nĩ kĩĩtagwo thĩinĩ wa njiaro cia Nuhu na thĩinĩ wa anabii (Genesis 10:4; Isaiah 23:1).
Barnabas, 'son of encouragement', is a L: Barinaba, “mũriũ wa ũhoorerio”, aarĩ Mũlawi waciarĩirwo Kuporo (Acts 4:36).
Paul and Barnabas preach at Salamis and: Paulo na Barinaba nĩmaahunjirie Salami na Pafo, kũrĩa ngavana Serigio Paulo eetĩkirie (Acts 13:4-12).
Barnabas later returns to Cyprus with Ma: Thuutha Barinaba nĩacookire Kuporo na Mariko (Acts 15:39).
Tradition places the tomb of St Barnabas: Mũtugo nĩ ũigaga mbĩrĩra ya Mũtheru Barinaba hakuhĩ na Salami.
Maronite and Latin Catholics live in Cyp: Kuporo ĩrĩ na Akatholiki Amaroni na a Kilatini. Benedikto wa Ikũmi na Gatandatũ (2010) na Fransisko (2021) nĩmamĩceereire.
North-west Arabia was Midian, where Mose: Arabia wa rũgongo ithũĩro nĩ Midiani, kũrĩa Musa orĩire na akĩhikia. Paulo nĩathiire Arabia thuutha wa kũgarũrũka.
Moses flees Pharaoh to Midian and marrie: Musa nĩorĩire Firaũni agĩthiĩ Midiani, na akĩhikia Zipora, mwarĩ wa Jethero, mũthĩnjĩri-Ngai wa Midiani (Exodus 2:15-22; Exodus 3:1).
Isaiah sees camels from Midian and Ephah: Isaia nĩonire ngamĩĩra cia Midiani na Efa irehete thahabu na ũbani, ithomo rĩa Kuumĩrĩra kwa Mwathani (Isaiah 60:6).
Paul calls Sinai 'a mountain in Arabia': Paulo eetaga Sinai “kĩrĩma kĩrĩa kĩrĩ Arabia” (Galatians 4:25), na nĩathiire Arabia thuutha wa kũgarũrũka (Galatians 1:17).
Arabs were among those who heard the apo: Aarabu maarĩ thĩinĩ wa arĩa maaiguire atũmwo mũthenya wa Pentekoste (Acts 2:11).
Many Catholic migrant workers live in Sa: Saudi Arabia ĩrĩ na aruti wĩra aingĩ a kuuma mabũrũri mangĩ arĩa Akatholiki, arĩa marũgamagĩrĩrwo nĩ Vikariati ya Atũmwo ya Arabia ya Rũgongo. Mahoya ma Kanitha marĩ kũu nja matiitĩkĩrĩtio kuo.
Most scholars place the kingdom of Sheba: Arutani aingĩ maigaga ũthamaki wa Sheba Yemeni. Mũthamaki-mũtumia waguo nĩookire kũgeria ũũgĩ wa Solomoni.
The queen of Sheba visits Solomon with s: Mũthamaki-mũtumia wa Sheba nĩaceereire Solomoni arehete mĩrĩo mĩega, thahabu na mahiga ma goro (1 Kings 10:1-13).
Jesus says 'the queen of the south' came: Jesũ oigire atĩ “mũthamaki-mũtumia wa mũhuro” oimire mũthia-inĩ wa thĩ gũũka kũigua Solomoni (Matthew 12:42).
'The kings of Sheba and Seba offer gifts: “Athamaki a Sheba na Seba nĩmakarehe iheo” nĩ rwĩnagwo Kuumĩrĩra-inĩ kwa Mwathani (Psalm 72:10).
Four Missionaries of Charity, sisters of: Masista mana a Amishonari a Wendo, kĩama kĩa Mũtheru Teresa wa Kolkata, nĩmooragirwo mweri wa Gatatũ 2016 mũciĩ-inĩ wao wa akũrũ kũu Aden.
The Bible's 'Ethiopia' (Cush) mainly mea: “Kushi” wa Bibilia kaingĩ nĩ wonanagia mabũrũri marĩa marĩ hũgũrũrũ cia Nile mwena wa mũhuro wa Misiri, Sudan ya ũmũthĩ. Ethiopia ya ũmũthĩ ĩrĩ na ũmwe wa mĩtugo ya Akristiano ya tene mũno thĩ yothe.
The Persian king rules 'from India to Et: Mũthamaki wa Perisia aathanaga “kuuma India nginya Kushi” (Esther 1:1).
Philip baptizes an Ethiopian official, t: Filipu nĩabatithirie mũnene Mũethiopia, mũigi wa mbeca wa Mũthamaki-mũtumia Kandake (Acts 8:26-40).
Ethiopia became Christian in the 4th cen: Ethiopia yatuĩkire ya Akristiano karine-inĩ ka kana na njĩra ya Mũtheru Frumentio, ũrĩa watuĩkirio mbishobu nĩ Mũtheru Athanasio wa Alekisandiria.
Ethiopian tradition traces its kings to: Mũtugo wa Aethiopia ugaga athamaki ao moimire kũrĩ Solomoni na Mũthamaki-mũtumia wa Sheba, na atĩ Ithandũkũ rĩa Kĩrĩkanĩro rĩrĩ Aksum.
The Ethiopian Catholic Church celebrates: Kanitha Katholiki wa Aethiopia nĩ ũkũngũyagĩra Liturgia ya tene na rũthiomi rwa Ge'ez.
Biblical Cush was mainly the land of Nub: Kushi wa Bibilia kaingĩ nĩ Nubia hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia Nile, thĩinĩ wa Sudan ya ũmũthĩ. Athamaki aguo nĩmaathanire o na Misiri.
Isaiah addresses the 'land of buzzing in: Isaia aragia na “bũrũri wa mathagu marĩa mahuuhaga, ũrĩa ũrĩ mũringo wa njũũĩ cia Kushi” (Isaiah 18:1-7).
Tirhakah, king of Cush, marches against: Tirihaka, mũthamaki wa Kushi, nĩathiire kũrũa na Ashuri (2 Kings 19:9).
Candace, the queen served by the officia: Kandake, mũthamaki-mũtumia ũrĩa mũnene ũrĩa wabatithirio nĩ Filipu aatungatagĩra, rĩarĩ rĩĩtwa rĩa athamaki-atumia a Meroe kũu Nubia (Acts 8:27).
St Josephine Bakhita was born in Darfur,: Mũtheru Josefina Bakhita aaciarĩirwo Darfur, akĩnyitwo ta ngombo arĩ kaana, agĩtuĩka sista wa Akanosia thĩinĩ wa Italia. Eetirwo mũtheru mwaka wa 2000.
St Daniel Comboni, missionary bishop of: Mũtheru Daniele Komboni, mbishobu mũmishonari wa Khartoum, nĩakuĩrĩire kuo mwaka wa 1881.
The Greek city of Cyrene, on the coast o: Itũũra inene rĩa Ngiriki hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia iria cia irathĩro cia Libya, Kurene nĩ mũciĩ wa Simoni ũrĩa wateithirie Jesũ gũkuua mũtharaba.
Simon of Cyrene is made to carry Jesus': Simoni wa Kurene nĩahatĩrĩirio gũkuua mũtharaba wa Jesũ (Mark 15:21; Luke 23:26).
Jews from 'the districts of Libya near C: Mũthenya wa Pentekoste nĩ kwarĩ Ayahudi “kuuma mabũrũri ma Libya hakuhĩ na Kurene” (Acts 2:10).
Men from Cyrene are among the first to p: Andũ a Kurene maarĩ thĩinĩ wa a mbere kũhunjĩria Angiriki a Antiokia kiugo, na Lukio wa Kurene nĩarutanire kuo (Acts 11:20; Acts 13:1).
2 Maccabees is a summary of five books b: Ibuku rĩa kerĩ rĩa Amakabayo nĩ ũhunjo mũkuhĩ wa mabuku matano ma Jasoni wa Kurene (2 Maccabees 2:23).
Simon of Cyrene is remembered at the Fif: Simoni wa Kurene nĩ aririkanagwo Handũ-inĩ ha gatano ha Njĩra ya Mũtharaba.
Paul hoped to preach in Spain. The far-o: Paulo nĩeerĩgagĩrĩra kũhunjia Spain. Wũmbĩro wa kũraya wa Tarishishi, kũrĩa Jona aageririe kũũrĩra, kaingĩ nĩ wĩciragio warĩ mwena wa mũhuro wa Spain, o na gũtuĩka ndũrĩ ũmĩrĩrio.
Jonah tries to flee from the Lord on a s: Jona nĩageririe kũũrĩra Mwathani akĩhaica ngarĩ ya maaĩ yathiiaga Tarishishi (Jonah 1:3).
The Romans conquer 'the land of Spain' f: Aroma nĩmaatunyire “bũrũri wa Spain” nĩ ũndũ wa irima ciaguo cia betha na thahabu (1 Maccabees 8:3).
Paul plans to visit the Roman Christians: Paulo nĩathugundire gũceerera Akristiano a Roma rĩrĩa angĩathiiaga Spain (Romans 15:24-28).
St Clement of Rome wrote that Paul reach: Mũtheru Klementi wa Roma nĩaandĩkire atĩ Paulo nĩakinyire “mũhaka-inĩ wa ithũĩro”, ũrĩa aingĩ mataũkagĩrwo nĩ Spain.
Tradition holds that St James the Greate: Kũringana na mũtugo, Mũtheru Jakubu ũrĩa Mũnene nĩahunjirie Spain. Handũ hake hatheru kũu Santiago de Compostela nĩ ho mũthia wa rũgendo rũtheru rwa Camino.
Our Lady of the Pillar in Zaragoza recal: Maitũ Witũ wa Gĩtugĩ kũu Zaragoza nĩ aririkanagia mũtugo atĩ Maria nĩonekire kũrĩ Jakubu kuo.
The 'mountains of Ararat' where the ark: “Irĩma cia Ararati”, kũrĩa ithanwa rĩarũgamire, nĩ cionanagia ũthamaki wa tene wa Urartu, gĩcigo-inĩ kĩa Armenia na irathĩro rĩa Turkey ya ũmũthĩ.
Sennacherib's sons flee to 'the land of: Aariũ a Senakeribu nĩmorĩire “bũrũri-inĩ wa Ararati” (2 Kings 19:37).
Jeremiah summons 'the kingdoms of Ararat: Jeremia eetaga “mothamaki ma Ararati, Mini na Ashikenazi” marũe na Babuloni (Jeremiah 51:27).
Armenia is traditionally the first natio: Kũringana na mũtugo, Armenia nĩguo bũrũri wa mbere gwĩtĩkĩra Ũkristiano, mwaka wa 301, na njĩra ya Mũtheru Gregori Mũmũrĩkĩri.
The Armenian Catholic Church is in full: Kanitha Katholiki wa Aarmenia ũrĩ ũrũmwe-inĩ ũrĩa mũiganu na Roma. Papa Fransisko nĩaceereire Armenia mwaka wa 2016, hamwe na nyũmba ya amonaki ya Khor Virap rungu rwa Ararati.
India marks the eastern edge of the Pers: Ibuku-inĩ rĩa Esiteri, India nĩguo mũhaka wa irathĩro wa Ũthamaki wa Perisia. Kũringana na mũtugo wa Akristiano, mũtũmwo Toma nĩahunjirie kuo.
King Ahasuerus rules 127 provinces 'from: Mũthamaki Ahasuero nĩathanire mabũrũri 127 “kuuma India nginya Kushi” (Esther 1:1; Esther 8:9).
An Indian driver rides each war elephant: O njogu ya mbaara thĩinĩ wa ita rĩa Aseleukidi yatwarũo nĩ mũtwari Mũhindi (1 Maccabees 6:37).
Tradition holds that St Thomas the Apost: Kũringana na mũtugo, Mũtheru Toma Mũtũmwo nĩahunjirie India na akĩũragwo ta mũira wa wĩtĩkio hakuhĩ na Chennai. Kanitha Mũnene wa San Thome ũrũgamĩte igũrũ rĩa mbĩrĩra yake.
The Syro-Malabar and Syro-Malankara Cath: Makanitha Katholiki ma Siro-Malabar na Siro-Malankara ma Kerala moigaga atĩ wĩtĩkio wao woimire kũrĩ we.
The holy city of David and Solomon's Tem: Itũũra inene itheru rĩa Daudi na rĩa Hekarũ ya Solomoni, handũ ha mĩnyamaro, gĩkuũ na kũriũka kwa Jesũ, na ha Pentekoste.
Melchizedek, king of Salem, brings out b: Melikisedeki, mũthamaki wa Salemu, nĩarehire mũgate na ndibei na akĩrathima Aburamu (Genesis 14:18-20).
Abraham is sent to offer Isaac in the la: Iburahĩmu eerirwo arute Isaaka igongona bũrũri-inĩ wa Moria, kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩrĩa Solomoni aakire Hekarũ thuutha (Genesis 22:2; 2 Chronicles 3:1).
David captures the city and makes it his: Daudi nĩatunyire itũũra inene na akĩrĩtua itũũra inene rĩa ũthamaki (2 Samuel 5:6-10). Solomoni nĩakire Hekarũ (1 Kings 6-8).
Babylon burns the Temple in 587 BC (2 Ki: Babuloni nĩĩacinire Hekarũ mwaka wa 587 mbere ya Kristo (2 Kings 25:8-10). Arĩa maacookire kuuma ũkombo-inĩ nĩmamĩakire rĩngĩ (Ezra 6:15).
Judas Maccabeus purifies and rededicates: Juda Makabayo nĩatheririe na akĩamũra rĩngĩ Hekarũ, gĩathĩ kĩrĩa Jesũ aakũngũĩire thuutha ta Gĩathĩ kĩa Kwamũrwo (1 Maccabees 4:36-59; John 10:22).
Jesus is presented in the Temple and fou: Jesũ nĩarutirwo Hekarũ-inĩ, na kũu nĩkuo oonirwo arĩ na mĩaka ikũmi na ĩĩrĩ (Luke 2:22-52).
He enters on Palm Sunday, shares the Las: Nĩatoonyire Kiumia kĩa Mathangũ, akĩrĩa Irio cia Hwaĩ-inĩ cia Mũthia, na akĩambĩrĩria Thakaramende ya Ukaristia (Matthew 21:1-11; Mark 14:12-25).
He is crucified and rises, and the Spiri: Nĩambirwo na akĩriũka, nake Roho Mũtheru agĩikũrũka mũthenya wa Pentekoste (John 19-20; Acts 2:1-41). Atũmwo nĩmaacemanĩire gũkũ mũcemanio-inĩ (Acts 15).
Catholics walk the Via Dolorosa, the Way: Akatholiki macangacangagĩra Via Dolorosa, Njĩra ya Mũtharaba thĩinĩ wa itũũra inene rĩa tene.
The Cenacle on Mount Zion is honoured as: Kĩhaaro kĩa Irio cia Hwaĩ-inĩ Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Zayuni nĩ gĩtĩĩagwo ta kĩhaaro kĩa igũrũ (Mark 14:15; Acts 1:13).
The Latin Patriarch of Jerusalem and the: Haha nĩ ho harĩ Mũpatriaki wa Kilatini wa Jerusalemu na Ũrũgamĩrĩri wa Afransisikani wa Bũrũri Mũtheru.
The place where Jesus was crucified and: Handũ harĩa Jesũ aambĩirwo na mbĩrĩra ĩrĩa ĩrĩ hakuhĩ kũrĩa aathikirwo na akĩriũka.
Jesus carries his cross to Golgotha and: Jesũ nĩakuuire mũtharaba wake nginya Golgotha na akĩambwo (John 19:17-30).
Mary his mother and the beloved disciple: Maria Nyina na mũrutwo ũrĩa eendete maarũgamĩte hakuhĩ na mũtharaba (John 19:25-27).
He is laid in a new tomb in a garden nea: Nĩaigirwo mbĩrĩra-inĩ njerũ mũgũnda-inĩ ũrĩa warĩ hakuhĩ (John 19:41-42).
On the first day of the week the tomb is: Mũthenya wa mbere wa kiumia mbĩrĩra ĩtarĩ na kĩndũ, na Jesũ Ũrĩa Wariũkire akĩonekera Maria Magadalena (John 20:1-18).
The Church of the Holy Sepulchre was bui: Kanitha Mũnene wa Mbĩrĩra Theru wakirwo nĩ Mũthamaki Konstantino na ũkĩamũrwo mwaka wa 335. Kũringana na mũtugo, nyina, Mũtheru Helena, nĩonire gũkũ Mũtharaba Mũtheru.
It is shared under an old agreement by C: Kũringana na kĩrĩkanĩro gĩa tene, ũgayanagio nĩ Akatholiki (Afransisikani), Aorthodoksi a Kĩngiriki, Aarmenia na angĩ. Handũ hatano ha mũthia ha Njĩra ya Mũtharaba harĩ thĩinĩ wa kanitha mũnene.
The hill east of Jerusalem where Jesus w: Kĩrĩma mwena wa irathĩro wa Jerusalemu kũrĩa Jesũ aarĩrĩire itũũra inene, akĩhooya arĩ na kĩeha Gethisemane, na akĩambata igũrũ.
David climbs the Mount of Olives weeping: Daudi nĩambatire Kĩrĩma kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ akĩrĩraga rĩrĩa orĩraga Abisalomu (2 Samuel 15:30).
Zechariah sees the Lord standing on the: Zekaria nĩonire Mwathani arũgamĩte Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ mũthenya wa Mwathani (Zechariah 14:4).
In Gethsemane he prays, 'not my will but: Gethisemane nĩahooire akiuga: “ti wendi wakwa, no wendi waku wĩkwo”, na akĩnyitwo (Luke 22:39-53; Mark 14:32-50).
He ascends into heaven from the mount ca: Nĩambatire igũrũ oimĩte kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩrĩa gĩĩtagwo kĩa Mĩtamaiyũ (Acts 1:9-12).
The Basilica of the Agony, or Church of: Kanitha Mũnene wa Kĩeha, ũrĩa wĩtagwo o na Kanitha wa Ndũrĩrĩ Ciothe, ũrũgamĩte Gethisemane hakuhĩ na mĩtamaiyũ ya tene.
Dominus Flevit, a tear-shaped Franciscan: Dominus Flevit, kanitha kanini ka Afransisikani kahaanaine ta itoonyĩ rĩa maithori, nĩ konanagia handũ harĩa Jesũ aarĩrire. Kanitha wa Pater Noster nĩ wonanagia Ihoya rĩa Mwathani na thiomi makĩria ya igana.
The town of David and the birthplace of: Itũũra inene rĩa Daudi na handũ harĩa Jesũ aaciarĩirwo.
Rachel is buried on the road to Ephrath,: Rakeli aathikirwo mũkĩra-inĩ wa njĩra ya Efirata, ũguo nĩ kuuga Bethilehemu (Genesis 35:19).
Ruth gleans in the fields of Boaz here (: Ruthu nĩacookanagĩrĩria haha mĩgũnda-inĩ ya Boazu (Ruth 2).
Samuel anoints the young shepherd David: Samueli nĩaitĩrĩrie maguta mũrĩithi mũnini Daudi (1 Samuel 16:1-13).
Micah foretells a ruler from 'Bethlehem-: Mika nĩarathire mũnene ũrĩa ũkoima “Bethilehemu Efirata” (Micah 5:1, Mabibilia-inĩ mamwe 5:2).
Jesus is born and laid in a manger, and: Jesũ nĩaciarirwo, akĩmamio kĩrĩĩro-inĩ kĩa nyamũ, nao arĩithi magĩũka (Luke 2:1-20).
The Magi worship him, and Herod kills th: Andũ oogĩ nĩmamũhooire, nake Herode akĩũraga Twana Tũtheru Tũtarĩ na Mahĩtia (Matthew 2:1-18).
The Church of the Nativity, first built: Kanitha Mũnene wa Gũciarwo, ũrĩa wakirwo mbere hĩndĩ ya Konstantino, nĩ ũmwe wa makanitha ma tene mũno marĩa mahũthagĩrwo hatarĩ gũtigithia. Ngurunga-inĩ, njata ya betha nĩ yonanagia handũ harĩa Kristo aaciarĩirwo.
St Jerome lived here from 386 and transl: Mũtheru Jerome nĩaikarire gũkũ kuuma 386 na akĩgarũra gĩcunjĩ kĩnene kĩa Bibilia na Kilatini, Vulgata, ngurunga-inĩ ĩrĩa ĩrĩ hakuhĩ na Ngurunga ya Gũciarwo.
Midnight Mass at Christmas is celebrated: Mĩĩsa ya gatagatĩ ka ũtukũ ya Thikukuu nĩ ĩkũngũyagĩrwo kanitha-inĩ wa Afransisikani wa Mũtheru Katarina ũrĩa ũrĩ hakuhĩ.
By tradition the home of Zechariah and E: Kũringana na mũtugo, nyũmba ya Zakaria na Elizabeth, kũrĩa Maria aathiire gũceerera na akĩina Magnifikati, na kũrĩa Johana Mũbatithania aaciarĩirwo.

The Cave of the Apocalypse and the Monas: Ngurunga ya Kũguũrĩrio na Nyũmba ya amonaki ya Mũtheru Johana (ĩrĩa yambĩrĩirio 1088) nĩ cia Aorthodoksi a Kĩngiriki na nĩ Handũ ha Igai rĩa Thĩ ha UNESCO.
Bay on Crete's south coast where Paul's: Gũkũrũ hũgũrũrũ-inĩ cia mũhuro cia Kirete kũrĩa ngarĩ ya maaĩ ya ohe ĩrĩa yakuuĩte Paulo yehithire kĩhuhũkanio gĩtanooka.
The ship reaches 'a place called Fair Ha: Ngarĩ ya maaĩ ĩrakinya “handũ heetagwo Mĩũmbĩro Mwega” hakuhĩ na Lasea; Paulo aramakaania matige gũthiĩ na mbere (Acts 27:7-12).
Paul leaves Titus in Crete to appoint el: Paulo aratiga Tito Kirete nĩguo athuure athuuri o itũũra (Titus 1:5).
Capital of the empire, where Paul preach: Itũũra inene rĩa ũthamaki, kũrĩa Paulo aahunjirie arĩ mũohe na kũrĩa, kũringana na mũtugo, Petero na Paulo maaheanire mĩoyo yao. Mbĩrĩra ya Petero ĩrĩ rungu rwa Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũtheru Petero.
Judas Maccabeus sends envoys to Rome to: Juda Makabayo aratũma atũmwo Roma gũthondeka kĩrĩkanĩro (1 Maccabees 8:17-20).
Paul writes to 'all the beloved of God i: Paulo araandĩkĩra “arĩa othe eendwo nĩ Ngai arĩa marĩ Roma”, arĩa wĩtĩkio wao “ũrahunjio thĩ yothe” (Romans 1:7-8).
Paul arrives as a prisoner and for two y: Paulo arakinya arĩ mũohe, na mĩaka ĩĩrĩ akamũkĩra arĩa othe mookaga kũrĩ we, “akĩhunjagia ũthamaki wa Ngai” (Acts 28:16-31).
Peter sends greetings from the church 'i: Petero aratũma ngeithi kuuma Kanitha-inĩ “wa Babuloni”, ũrĩa aingĩ mataũkagĩrwo nĩ Roma (1 Peter 5:13). Jesũ ararathĩra ũrĩa Petero agaakua (John 21:18-19).
Peter was crucified on the Vatican Hill: Petero nĩambirwo Kĩrĩma-inĩ kĩa Vatikani hĩndĩ ya Nero, ta mwaka wa 64-67 thuutha wa Kristo, na Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũtheru Petero ũrũgamĩte igũrũ rĩa mbĩrĩra yake. Wenji wa rungu rwa kĩgongona kĩnene nĩwanĩrĩirwo nĩ Pio wa Ikũmi na Kerĩ mwaka wa 1950.
Paulo nĩatinirio mũtwe njĩra-inĩ ya Ostia. Kanitha Mũnene wa Mũtheru Paulo Nja ya Thingo nĩ ũigĩte mbĩrĩra yake.
The Church celebrates both apostles toge: Kanitha nĩ ũkũngũyagĩra atũmwo acio eerĩ hamwe mũthenya wa 29 mweri wa Gatandatũ.
The busy port near Naples where Paul lan: Wũmbĩro ũrĩa ũrĩ na andũ aingĩ hakuhĩ na Naples kũrĩa Paulo aakinyĩire Italia na akĩona Akristiano marĩ kuo o mbere.
At Puteoli 'we found some brothers and w: Kũu Puteoli “nĩtwonire ariũ a Ithe witũ, nao magĩtũthaitha tũikare nao mĩthenya mũgwanja. Na ũguo nĩguo twakinyire Roma” (Acts 28:13-14).
Christians from Rome come out to meet hi: Akristiano a Roma moima gũcemania nake Thoko-inĩ ya Apio na Nyũmba-inĩ Ithatũ cia Ageni (Acts 28:15).
Where tradition says Paul's ship ran agr: Kũrĩa mũtugo ugaga atĩ ngarĩ ya maaĩ ya Paulo yarũgamire mũthanga-inĩ kũu Malta.
The ship strikes a sandbar and all reach: Ngarĩ ya maaĩ ĩrahũũra mũthanga, nao othe magakinya thĩ nyũmũ marĩ muoyo (Acts 27:39-44).
A viper fastens on Paul's hand as he gat: Nyoka ĩranyiita guoko kwa Paulo rĩrĩa aracookanĩrĩria ngũ, nake akamĩkũkũmũra mwaki-inĩ atekũgĩa na ũũru (Acts 28:3-6).
Paul heals the father of Publius, the is: Paulo arahonia ithe wa Publio, mũnene wa gĩcigĩrĩra (Acts 28:7-10).
A statue of St Paul stands on St Paul's: Mbica ya Mũtheru Paulo ĩrũgamĩte Icigĩrĩra-inĩ cia Mũtheru Paulo gũkũrũ-inĩ. Malta nĩ ĩkũngũyagĩra mũthenya wa 10 mweri wa Kerĩ Gĩathĩ kĩa Kuuna kwa Ngarĩ ya Maaĩ ya Mũtheru Paulo.
The Roman capital of Cyprus, where the p: Itũũra inene rĩa Aroma thĩinĩ wa Kuporo, kũrĩa ngavana Serigio Paulo eetĩkirie.
Paul and Barnabas preach in the synagogu: Paulo na Barinaba marahunjia thunagogi-inĩ cia Salami (Acts 13:5).
At Paphos the magician Elymas is struck: Kũu Pafo mũrogi Elima aratuĩka mũtumumu, nake ngavana Serigio Paulo agetĩkia (Acts 13:6-12). Kuuma hau Luka eetaga Saulo “Paulo”.
St Paul's Pillar at the church of Agia K: Gĩtugĩ kĩa Mũtheru Paulo kanitha-inĩ wa Agia Kyriaki Chrysopolitissa nĩ kĩonanagio ta handũ harĩa Paulo aahũũrirwo. Kanitha ũcio ũhũthagĩrwo nĩ Akatholiki na Aangilikani.
Greek city of Libya, home of Simon who c: Itũũra inene rĩa Angiriki thĩinĩ wa Libya, mũciĩ wa Simoni ũrĩa wakuuire mũtharaba wa Jesũ, na wa Jasoni, ũrĩa ũhoro wake watuĩkire ibuku rĩa kerĩ rĩa Amakabayo.
Simon, a Cyrenian, 'the father of Alexan: Simoni, mũndũ wa Kurene, “ithe wa Alekisanda na Rufo”, arahatĩrĩrio gũkuua mũtharaba (Mark 15:21).
2 Maccabees condenses the five books of: Ibuku rĩa kerĩ rĩa Amakabayo nĩ rĩkuhĩhagia mabuku matano ma Jasoni wa Kurene (2 Maccabees 2:19-32).
Men of Cyrene first preach the Lord Jesu: Arũme a Kurene nĩo maambĩrĩria kũhunjĩria Angiriki kũu Antiokia ũhoro wa Mwathani Jesũ (Acts 11:20).
Royal city of Nubia, whose queens bore t: Itũũra inene rĩa ũthamaki rĩa Nubia, rĩrĩa athamaki-atumia aguo meetagwo Kandake, ta mũthamaki-mũtumia ũrĩa mũnene wabatithirio nĩ Filipu aatungatagĩra.
Tirhakah, king of Cush, marches against: Tirihaka, mũthamaki wa Kushi, arathiĩ kũrũa na Senakeribu (2 Kings 19:9).
'Look, there is water. What is to preven: “Rora, maaĩ maya. Nĩ kĩĩ kĩngĩngiria kũbatithio?” Mũnene wa Kandake arabatithio na agathiĩ na rũgendo rwake akenete (Acts 8:26-39).
The Ethiopian official is honoured as on: Mũnene Mũethiopia nĩ atĩĩagwo ta ũmwe wa andũ a Ndũrĩrĩ a mbere kũbatithio, Korinelio atanabatithio.
